title: shadPS4 0.6.0: official stable release
summary: shadPS4 published 0.6.0 on January 31, 2025. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.6.0 on January 31, 2025. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official release description states: A new release first of this year. A lot of things has been improved since last release , making a lot of new games playable and some others has interesting progress . Below is a short list of what's changed Improved Devtools Improvements in shader recompiler Added sceGnmGetEqEventType/sceKernelGetEventData Improvements to audio backend (SDL) Improved HLE fibers library Motion Controls implementation Improvements to savedata Unmap Fixes Implemented sceNpCmp functions GUI: Speed up GUI loading by caching game sizes sceKernelAio implementation Fixes to several Surface Formats Fix for address space initialization on Windows sceKernelVirtualQuery Fixes.
